citation.authors: Taylor SM, Parobek CM, Fairhurst RM

cited_by.title: Sickle cell disease, trait and pregnancy

record.population: 62 studies of children and pregnant women in malaria regions
record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of haemoglobinopathies and malaria
record.finding: Haemoglobin AS (the trait) cut the risk of severe falciparum malaria (odds ratio 0.09, 95% CI 0.06-0.12) and was the only genotype consistently protective against uncomplicated malaria (incidence rate ratio 0.69, 95% CI 0.61-0.79).
record.note: Explains why the gene is common where malaria is, not a benefit for people living elsewhere.
